newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Bird plunges Senegal into darkness.
newsitem.headline: Bird plunges Senegal into darkness.

text.p: A sparrow hawk plunged Senegal into darkness for four hours after short-circuiting the national electricity grid, officials said on Saturday.
Friday night's incident began after dusk when the bird collided with one high tension power line causing it to short against another.
"This resulted in an abrupt short circuit causing a total blackout throughout the country," Adiouma Dione, a senior official of the state power company SENELEC, told Reuters.
He explained that the incident occurred at the Cap de Biches power plant which produces about 80 percent of the nation's electricity.
A protective mechanism automatically shut down the other two power stations at Saint Louis and Koalack, he said. The sparrow hawk perished.
